visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs wearing a white long-sleeved top is seated on a grey couch. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy, using a pointing gesture with her right index finger. Digital confetti and colorful streamers appear as overlays at 0:01 against a plain light wall background. (2) The scene shifts outdoors to a park or street setting; she is now wearing a black T-shirt with the 'Uber Eats' logo and carrying a large green thermal delivery bag. She gestures towards the bag and waves. (3) Inside a residential hallway with a dark brown door and a wooden shoe cabinet, she is seen crouching and arranging Pizza Hut boxes. She presses a doorbell and then ducks out of view as a woman with dark hair opens the door to find the food. (4) A graphic transition shows a cartoon version of the woman riding a red scooter against a bright green background with the text '出發送幸福'. (5) Back outdoors on an urban street, she delivers more pizza boxes to a young man in a black hoodie in a lobby area. They stand near glass doors and high-pitched variety-show text overlays appear next to them. (6) She delivers to a third person, a woman with glasses and a grey skirt on a sidewalk near a 7-Eleven. (7) Finally, she is back indoors, sitting at a table filled with various Pizza Hut boxes and a can of 7-Up. She is seen taking bites of the pizza, showing the cheese pull and side dishes with high enthusiasm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voiceover speaking quickly in Mandarin, accompanied by a bright, high-tempo electronic pop BGM (approx. 128 BPM). There is a sharp 'ding' sound effect as graphics appear on screen. (2) At 0:15, a distinct doorbell chime SFX triggers a transition. The vocal remains excited, describing the plan to deliver food. The BGM maintains a steady, driving kick drum. (3) Each pizza delivery is marked by incidental sounds of cardboard rustling and human laughter from the recipients. A 'whoosh' sound effect occurs during the transition to the cartoon scooter segment. (4) In the final phase, loud, crisp 'crunch' SFX are prominent as the speaker bites into the pizza. The vocal tone becomes more descriptive and indulgent, mixed with the ongoing upbeat BGM and occasional 'pop' UI sound effects for on-screen text.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional collaboration between the creator, Uber Eats, and Pizza Hut. It celebrates the creator reaching 900,000 subscribers while highlighting Uber Eats' 9th anniversary. The narrative follows the creator as she 'delivers happiness' to her team and friends, finally showcasing the specific '9th Anniversary Limited Deluxe Individual Set' from Pizza Hut with an enthusiastic tasting segment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator wears a branded T-shirt, carries a branded delivery bag, and explicitly discusses the promotion and anniversary offers for Uber Eats and Pizza Hut.
